title: Nvidia asked for this... RTX 5070 vs RTX 4090- The Ultimate Comparison!!!
description:
Nvidia famously claimed that the RTX 5070 is as powerful as a 4090 for $549. So today we put that test to the claim, including an analysis of whether DLSS 4 multi-frame-generation allows the 5070 to match the 4090.
